scheme: SM uses MSbar throughout. MSSM uses MSbar below MS and DRbar after the universal ordinary superpartner step with A_MS-A_DR=C_adj/(12pi). Both extra vectorlike supermultiplets are internally mass-degenerate even if a partner lies below MS. No other nonuniversal finite thresholds, two-loop terms or independent high-scale kinetic splitting in the stipulated leading matching.
